title: Normalized diagonal coefficient diagrams
statement: Using the actual maps of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-maps], the diagram categories of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category] and the scalar compatibilities of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars], define the following coefficient-family notation. Finite extensions and their integer rings are those of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]; integral quotient coefficients are those of [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x]. A family consists of these diagrams for $\mathbf Z_\ell$, all $\mathcal O_E$, all $E$ and the finite-extension-valued $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], using exactly the integral, rational and colimit positive Tate lines of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist], and scalar compatibilities for their actual inclusion, localization, finite-subextension transition and colimit maps. The $\mathbf Z_\ell$ line is restriction of the bottom finite subextension's integral line. Integral root maps are determined by every root-limit projection followed by the free-module unit. Finite root comparisons are determined by their kernel inclusions into units, and their maps to finite Cartier lines use [def-sp-comparison-forget-scalars]. The uniformizer quotient coefficient, line and line map mean the actual quotient map, ordinary scalar extension and extension unit. All supported sources and Cartier lines use the interface of [def-sfb-geo-cartier-canonical-class].
